regions.merged_text: Our divine Lord Himself admonishes us to be on our guard continually. "Watch ye and pray that ye en- ter not into temptation." And St. Peter, "Brethern, be sober and watch; for your adversary the D. as a roaring lion goeth about seeking whom he may devour." In other words, according to today's parable, if we wish to be the wheat of God and not the cockle of satan or gathered in with -- we must fight against our own evil inclinations; we must beware of danger- ous company, of dangerous amusement. We must culti- vate the Christian virtues -- we must heed the invi- tation, the command of the Church - aye of Jesus Christ Himself, to receive Him -- Come to me all ye that labor and are heavily burdened and --- you, --- bearing in mind that as the purpose of the cockle is to choke out the wheat and to corrupt the golden grain that grows in spite of it, so the cockle of vice, of bad example, of passion in our hearts will always try to choke us out from being worthy of the Kingdom of Heaven. Let us not sleep therefore, in God's service but be grate- ful and vigilent that in the time of the harvest - in the day of Judgement we may be gathered into the Heaven of eternal glory. Amen.

regions.merged_text: "The elevation to the Chair of Peter places a man upon the greatest height of earthly greatness, but with this greatness there goes, too, the burden of its high and heavy duties, together with immesur- able responsibility before God, before the world and before the people. Amid the profound upheavals and vast changes in the political, social, and indus trial life of the present, there must be an added sense of the heavy burden that goes with the triple crown. " -- 1.64 No diocesan synod in Mantua for two hundred years till Bishop Sarto convened one in 1888. Votes for Pius X in conclave were 5-10-20-24-27-35-50 Saturday A.M. 5 Tuesday A.M. 50
